Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa
one of the eighteen Purāṇas; acc. to the Kūrmapurāṇa it was proclaimed by Vāyu glorifying the Brahmāṇḍa; the original work may be a. earlier version of the Vāyupurāṇa. Acc. to Matsyapurāṇa, this work was proclaimed by Brahman an. it consists of 12,200 verses glorifying the cosmic egg giving a. account of the future Kalpas. Apart from the text some mss. of this work contain only Māhātmyas, Stotras an. Upākhyānas forming parts of this Purāṇa.
See Wint. HIL. I. p.. 551-52.
